summary: Frontend E2E tested for Iteration 9 Maintenance Controls Sheet flow. All new UI features work: Controlli grid, VehicleControlsDialog with OK/KO buttons, check dialog with optional km (prefilled from last known), OK/KO recording, KO auto-chaining an intervention dialog prefilled with vehicle (locked) and description, history table with OK/KO/km/operator, Excel & PDF export, vehicle card shows last known km, intervention completion with km field, filters and Stats tab regression. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Manutenzione.jsx is ~410 lines - still under threshold but growing. Consider extracting VehicleControlsDialog / CheckDialog / AddInterventionDialog / CompleteInterventionDialog into separate files for future maintainability.
KM prefill on the very first OK check for a vehicle without prior km is empty (expected behavior). After the first km recorded, subsequent check dialogs correctly prefill with last km.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 OK checks + 1 KO check on vehicle AB123CD (Olio motore); created 1 intervention (auto from KO) and completed it with cost 120,50€ and km 85.100. Cleanup not performed (per note it's fine to leave on existing vehicles).
